reuseJustification.text: The ranking was collected to find out which characteristics matter most to deployed soldiers; CBO reused it as the weighting for a requirements trade-off and states that derivation in its methodology appendix (pp. 33–34).

text: CBO's primary-metric weights are the Army's category weights for the four categories CBO could assess, renormalised to sum to one (CBO writes 'based on'; Table A-1's figures make it an exact renormalisation); the Army derived those from rankings given by soldiers who had deployed with combat brigades.
